Name: Fountain
Description: The water of a fountain, as a sound: a jet breaking up over a bowl, the bowl overflowing into the basin, rim jets arching in. Not a recording and not a loop: drops striking the pool and the bubbles they trap, each ringing at the note its size gives it (WaterFeatureSpec.ParkFountain, FallingWaterSynth). The basin and the bowl are the boxes round it; this is only where the water is.
